title: Beam with a cantilever: reactions and uplift at the back support

rubric.text: The response should take moments about B and recognise that support A is pulled upward (uplift), so it needs a hold-down or tension connection.

expert_notes: Moments about B: RA x 4 = 5 x 4 x 2 - 20 x 2 x 1 - 10 x 2 = 40 - 40 - 20 = -20, RA = -5 kN (uplift). RB = 20 + 40 + 10 + 5 = 75 kN, more than the 70 kN total. Tributary thinking gives RA = +10 kN downward and misses the uplift.
